FN-R5QRMM-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 72
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Jerry Starnes
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/20/2023
House Bill 72 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Corrections by
an estimated $28 for each day a parolee remains in a county jail past the 20 business day
window provided by current law, due to a delay in holding a parole violation hearing as
provided by this bill.
